calls.thesis: His pick among the 4 neo-clouds: ~500% revenue growth, best debt-to-FCF in group (-1.8x), growth-adjusted P/S 9.8x vs 45x headline. Still pricey and he's leery of the whole neo-cloud model — 'take another look', not a full buy.
calls.base_case: 500% revenue growth + best balance sheet of the four.
calls.bear_case: Technological obsolescence forces constant data-center reloads; all four cash-flow negative.
